item.title: The Redistricting Scheme That Could Help Dems Retake the House
item.description: Democrats are seeking to redraw New York City’s 11th Congressional District, encompassing Staten Island and a portion of Brooklyn.

item.title: Bongino Reveals What Triggered Viral Post About Being 'Shocked' to His 'Core' at FBI
item.description: Bongino wrote in the post, which garnered 20.5 million views, that he would “never be the same” following the revelations in the documents.

item.title: College Basketball Player Shot to Death While Driving on Tennessee Highway - 1 Clue Might Help Solve the Murder
item.description: Both passengers told police they were distracted by their cellphones when they suddenly heard multiple gunshots.

item.title: CNN Legal Analyst Delivers Bad News to Anti-ICE Dems: Their Lawsuit Is About to Go Up in Flames
item.description: Elie Honig said the most the suit could gain would be “information” after Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar of Minnesota discussed the situation.

item.title: Radical Groups Like Renee Good's Are Tailing ICE All Over America
item.description: Renee Good volunteered for the Minnesota branch of “ICE Watch,” a web of residents notifying each other about nearby ICE operations.

item.title: Five Severed Human Heads Discovered Hanging on Beach in Apparent Drug Cartel Warning
item.description: A wooden sign that was positioned next to the remains contained a written message with an alrming warning.

item.title: California Mom Convicted of Murder After Drinking and Going Online for Dates as Daughter Drowned
item.description: Prosecutors proved that the mother's neglect while drunk directly resulted in the little girl’s drowning death.

item.title: Blue State Raids 'Emergency' Funds to Pay Off Student Loans, Could Fuel 'Unsustainable' Borrowing
item.description: Connecticut lawmakers are calling for the use of state emergency funds to replace the federal GradPLUS program.

item.title: Leftist with 'Any Pronouns' Arrested for Assassination Threats Against Conservatives on Campus
item.description: Dean Stewart, whose LinkedIn page invites people to refer to him with “any pronouns,” was charged with threat of violence.

item.title: St. Louis Calls Off Search for Band of Monkeys Allegedly Accompanied by a Goat After AI Images Flood Social Media
item.description: The fake reports complicated efforts to track real sightings. With actual leads exhausted, city officials quietly suspended the search.
